title: Percentage of a round number
rationale: Discounts, tax rates and margin checks are routinely computed as percentages; a wrong percentage silently distorts pricing decisions and financial summaries.

prompt.content: You are a precise calculator. Answer with the number only.

notes: Expected value 36, verified with Python: 0.15 * 240 = 36.0. Deterministic: static prompt, temperature 0, single number-only answer. Brittleness: a reply that restates the percentage setup with several numbers would let the first-number rule pick the wrong value, so the system message requires a bare number.
